pwa-guide.title: Installation
pwa-guide.description: Depending on the browser, this may look a little different. Find the "Add to Home Screen" option in the browser menu (which is usually opened by a button in the corner of the screen), then select "Install." The app will appear as an icon on your device's home screen or desktop.
pwa-guide.ios-description: Unfortunately, web application installation on iOS only works in Safari browser. To install the app, open Safari's menu (the box with an arrow pointing up), then scroll down and select "Add to Home Screen." The app will appear as an icon on your device's home screen.
pwa-guide.image-hint: Click the image to open it in a new view and be able to zoom in
pwa-guide.android-recommendation: NOTE: It looks like you're on an Android device. We strongly recommend you to use this installation method (click to see) instead of the one below.

android-guide.warning: This works ONLY on Android devices. If you're on a different platform, click here

security-verification.title: Security verification
security-verification.header: This page will work in the future. Go back and pretend everything's ok :P
security-verification.description: This verification will help you ensure that no one has messed with the encryption parameters between you and this user (public keys / security codes).
security-verification.step-1-description:
Exchange these codes via a safe communications channel (other than this app) or physically.
Verify if both your and {{name}}'s code are exactly the same on both devices.
(your device's A must match their device's B and vice versa).
security-verification.step-2-description: Your conversations are only secure if both pairs do match. Mismatch is a critical alert. Once verified successfully, there's no need to redo this in the future.

login.register-hint: I don't have an account yet

register.phone-input: Phone with country code. Used for logging in and discovering other users

profile.name: Username

block.user: The user will be hidden for you, you won't receive notifications. They won't be informed of this action. You can unblock them later from the Conversations list page.

install.description: but you have to do it yourself. Depending on the browser, it may look different, but usually you need to click the menu icon in one of the screen corners (3 dots or 3 lines), and then find the option "Install app" (best!) or, if that doesn't exist, "Add to home screen".

prompt.unblock: Are you sure you want to unblock this user?
prompt.clear-conversation: All your messages in the conversation(s) will be permanently deleted. This action cannot be undone.
prompt.delete-message: Are you sure you want to delete your message(s), for all users?
prompt.conversation-exists: A conversation with this user already exists. Do you want to open it?

server-unavailable.description: It's either due to your internet connection or the app server being down. No data can be loaded. Check your connection or try again later.

no-internet.description: Data can't be loaded until you're online again

data-unavailable.description: Couldn't load data - this might be due to a problem with your connection, the app server, a bad URL, or missing permissions.

not-found.description: The data you wanted to view hasn't been found. This is likely due to a bad URL or a problem with internet/server connection. Try going back to the app home page.

bad-url.description: Try going back to the home page

unauthorized.description: Session expired - please log in again (Conversations list > Options > App settings > Log out). Otherwise, you won't be able to load any data.

server-error.description: The server has returned an unexpected internal error. Contact the administrator if the issue persists.

data-invalid.description: Provided data is invalid. Check the if the input is correct.

unknown.description: An unknown error has occured. If the issue persists, try restarting the app completely or contact the administrator.

logout-failed.description: An error occurred while logging out. If necessary, try erasing the browser cookies and data.

bad-timestamp.description: Check your device's date and time settings and set the correct time (yes, this is actually important)

notifications-blocked.description: To enable notifications, you have to go to your browser or device settings and manually allow them (this is out of the app's control)
